profile_text.body:
InVideo is a video creation platform whose website centers on a product called InVideo Agent Two, described as a tool for creating and editing AI-generated videos. The company describes its agents as storing a project's full context in long-term memory to keep clips consistent across a production, and as capable of selecting an AI model and writing prompts for individual shots based on a user's scene description.

The company claims that its invideo agent ranks first on Physion-Arc, described on the site as an independent AI video benchmark. InVideo's product is categorized as a video generation and editing tool, and the company's primary offering carries the InVideo name.
